adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/admin/templates/group.hbs` the list is rendered with `{{each member in members itemView="group-member"}}`, which establishes the per-item context as the iterated `member` (a `Discourse.User`). In `admin/templates/group_member.hbs`, the conditional `{{#unless automatic}}` therefore resolves `automatic` against the user object, not the group/controller’s `automatic` flag. Since users don’t have `automatic`, it will be `undefined`/falsy and the remove link will render even for automatic groups, leading to a 422 when clicked (per `Admin::GroupsController#remove_member` guarding `group.automatic`).
